criteria.reasoning: The memo states "**No part of it goes to the gala**," rejects both the $3,000 and the $1,520 split, and rules out a second Kestrel grant "just for the table". The reply says "I can't move part of the grant to the table, and a second Kestrel grant for it wouldn't work either."

The memo says the invoice is "to be paid by Peggy and/or Erik by personal check or card — never from a donor-advised fund." The reply tells Peggy DAF grants "can't pay for any part of event tickets or tables" and that "a personal check or card is perfect."
The memo gives a "good-faith estimate **$1,360** (8 × $170, the per-seat value we used for the same table last year)." That is the 2025 figure the criterion names as wrong, not $1,480.
The memo includes the §6115 disclosure but states "**deductible amount: $1,640** ($3,000 − $1,360)," which the criterion specifically fails, instead of $1,520.

The memo directs the acknowledgment "to **Kestrel Charitable Trust** ... not to the Halvorsens." The draft states "a grant of $15,000.00" and "No goods or services were provided in exchange for this grant."

The Kestrel acknowledgment says "The grant has been applied to Margaret and Erik Halvorsen's Studio Wing pledge, which now has a balance of $5,000." The memo even explains "Mentioning the pledge lets Kestrel see the grant in context."
The reply to Peggy states "Your $15,000 gift is fully tax-deductible," which tells her the grant is deductible to her.

The reply never explains that Kestrel is the legal donor and receives the acknowledgment, so there is no receipt for her. It instead calls the gift "fully tax-deductible" and does not address her receipt request.
The memo books "Hard credit: Kestrel Charitable Trust," "Soft credit: Margaret and Erik Halvorsen," and "Designation: Studio Wing Campaign, as the grant letter states."
Section 4 is titled "Soft-credit the full grant to the Halvorsens' statement of intent". The table subtracts "Kestrel grant KCT-2026-0418833 (soft credit, full amount) | −$15,000."

The table shows "**Open balance after this grant** | **$5,000**" ($40,000 − $10,000 − $10,000 − $15,000). It states that the 2025 and 2026 gala tables "are event purchases and are not counted toward it."

The memo notes that the 2024-11-12 commitment on form SW-SOI "says in terms that it is **a statement of intention, not a legally binding pledge or obligation**." It adds that "Under §4.4.1 that is what allows a DAF grant they recommended to be soft-credited toward it."
